Answered.description: ``answered(q)``: true iff ``q`` has a value; the way to test presence (§3).
Answered.title: Answered

Arith.description: ``left op right`` for ``+ - * /``. Null in, null out (§3). ``/`` is decimal (§2).
Arith.title: Arith

AssignNode.description: Assigns each listed `assigned` variable one of its levels (semantics.md §7).
AssignNode.title: AssignNode

AssignedVariable.description: A between-subjects condition, set by an `assign` flow node (semantics.md §7).
AssignedVariable.title: AssignedVariable

Block.description: A named run of pages, placed in the flow by a `block` node.
Block.title: Block

BoolLit.description:
Boolean literal ``true`` or ``false``. Its static type is boolean, so it is a
condition on its own; as a condition only ``true`` is true (§3).
BoolLit.title: BoolLit

Choice.description:
One option. `value` is the code stored in data (semantics.md §2) and the option's
identity within its list.
Choice.title: Choice

ChoiceList.description: A shared choice list, referenced by questions through `choiceList`.
ChoiceList.title: ChoiceList

Compare.description: ``left op right``. Any comparison with null is false, even ``null == null`` (§3).
Compare.title: Compare

ComputedVariable.description: A value derived from other answers and variables (XLSForm `calculate`).
ComputedVariable.title: ComputedVariable

Consent.description:
The consent page (MVP 12b, semantics.md §11). Survey-level, not a flow node: it is
always shown first, before any question, at most once, and nothing about the
participant reaches the server before they agree.

- `text`: the information and consent statement (translatable; no piping).
- `agreeLabel` / `declineLabel`: the two buttons.
- `declineOutcome`: the end code of a decline (`declined`). A decline records no
  response; only `countDeclines` (off by default) keeps an anonymous count.

The consent version is the checksum of the texts as compiled (`osp_runtime.plan`), so
any edit to the wording is a new version, recorded with each response.
Consent.title: Consent

DecLit.description: Decimal literal, e.g. ``2.50``. Always finite; never a float (§2).
DecLit.title: DecLit

EmbeddedVariable.description: A value supplied at session start, e.g. from a URL parameter.
EmbeddedVariable.title: EmbeddedVariable

EndRedirect.description:
Where an ending sends the participant after the submit is acknowledged (end-of-survey
plan §4.2, task EN2; lead decision 2: `auto` after 5 s with a countdown, 0 allowed).

- `template`: a key of `settings.redirectTemplates` (or `hooks.redirects`).
- `params`: one entry per placeholder: a literal or a piped `${…}` value. The filled
  value must match the template's pattern, else no redirect is followed or shown.
  A param that pipes a *question* sends an answer to a third party: a data export, as
  for hooks (owner-confirmed, in the codebook, audited; `redirect.param_question`).
- `delay`: seconds before the automatic navigation; `0` navigates as soon as the submit
  is acknowledged, with no screen in between.
- `mode`: `auto` (countdown, then navigate; "Stay on this page" cancels) or `link` (no
  automatic navigation: the participant clicks the button).
- `label`: the button text; None: the app's own "Continue to {host}".
EndRedirect.title: EndRedirect

Ending.description:
What the participant sees when the session ends with one outcome (end-of-survey plan
§4.1, task EN1). `settings.endings` maps an outcome identifier (an end node's `outcome`,
a quota's `onFull.outcome`, the consent `declineOutcome`, the built-ins `complete` and
`hook-failed`) to its ending, so the screen, the data and the exports agree.

- `title`: the heading; None: the app's own translated "Thank you".
- `body`: the text under it, with piping (`${id}`, variables, built-ins) as on pages
  (semantics.md §8). Rendered as text, never as HTML. An end node's own `message` is
  shown above it.
- `status`: `auto` shows the app's own truthful line ("Your answers have been sent." when
  a response was recorded, "Nothing was recorded." for a decline); `none` hides it for a
  recorded response. Researcher text never replaces it; a decline always shows it.
- `summary`: `answers` lists the participant's own answers (every answered question in
  path order, with a Print button) under the body once the response is stored (§4.4,
  task EN5); `none` (default) shows nothing. Never for the consent decline
  (`ending.declined_summary`): nothing was recorded.
- `redirect`: where to send the participant afterwards (task EN2), or None.
Ending.title: Ending

ExternalTaskNode.description:
A flow node that sends the participant to an external task (a jsPsych/PsychoJS/Gorilla
experiment, or the lab's own page) and resumes the survey when they return (task EX2,
planning/external-tasks.md).

- `template`: a key of `settings.redirectTemplates` (or `hooks.redirects`): the external
  task's https URL, filled and checked exactly as an end redirect is (EN2).
- `params`: one entry per placeholder, a literal or a piped `${…}` value (a question,
  a variable or a built-in incl. `${$session.id}`). A piped answer is a data export.
- `returns`: embedded variables (`source: "url"`) the external task sends back in the
  return URL. On return each is captured into the session's URL parameters, like a
  start-time URL parameter: recorded, never trusted (the return URL is participant-visible).

The platform appends `osp_return` and `osp_token` (a signed, expiring, context-bound
return token) to the outbound URL; the external task echoes them to send the participant
back. A template placeholder may not be named `osp_return` or `osp_token`.
ExternalTaskNode.title: ExternalTaskNode

Heading.description: A heading relative to the page (rendered as h3–h5 under the page's h2).
Heading.title: Heading

HookHandler.description:
One event handler's declarations. ``ctx.results`` and ``ctx.vars`` hold only the
``reads``; ``setVariable`` is accepted only for the ``writes``.
HookHandler.title: HookHandler

HookParent.description: Messages the hooks may post to the embedding page: one origin, typed messages.
HookParent.title: HookParent

If.description:
``if(cond, a, b)``: ``a`` when ``cond`` is true, else ``b`` (semantics.md §3).

Lazy: only the chosen branch is evaluated. A null (or non-boolean) condition picks
``b``, like any condition that is not true. JSON: ``{"kind": "if", "cond": …,
"then": …, "else": …}``.
If.title: If

Instrument.description:
One instrument the survey uses (lead decision 1, question-bank.md): derived from the
`source` fields at publish (`osp_spec.bank.with_instruments`), so a published version
stays self-describing even if the bank item is later deleted.
Instrument.title: Instrument

MatrixQuestion.description:
Rows of single-choice sub-questions sharing one choice list (the columns).

The matrix itself stores no value: each row is its own variable with its own state
(semantics.md §2, C2c-1). Exactly one of `choiceList` / `choices` is set, as for choice
questions. Rows have no `showIf` or `constraint` of their own (C2c-2).
MatrixQuestion.title: MatrixQuestion

MatrixRow.description:
One row of a `matrix`: a single-choice sub-question with its own variable
(semantics.md §2, C2c-1). `id` is unique within its matrix; the row's variable id is
`<matrix id>_<row id>` and its export name `<matrix name>_<row id>`.
MatrixRow.title: MatrixRow

NoteQuestion.description: Display-only text. Stores no value, so it has no `name`, `required` or `constraint`.
NoteQuestion.title: NoteQuestion

Page.description: One screen. Validation runs on page submit (semantics.md §4).
Page.title: Page

Palette.description: The colours of one mode. Everything else on the page is derived from these.
Palette.title: Palette

PipeRun.description: A piped value: a question or variable id, or a `$` built-in (semantics.md §8).
PipeRun.title: PipeRun

QuotaFull.description:
What happens to a participant who hits a full quota (semantics.md §6): optionally
show `block` (at most one), then end with `outcome`. There is no `goto`.
QuotaFull.title: QuotaFull

RandomiserNode.description: Runs its children in a seeded random order, or `pick` of them (semantics.md §7).
RandomiserNode.title: RandomiserNode

RedirectTemplate.description:
An end-of-survey redirect template (runtime-design.md §7a; end-of-survey plan §4.2):
an https URL with `{name}` placeholders after the origin, each declared in `params`.
Declared in `settings.redirectTemplates` (task EN2) or, as before, in `hooks.redirects`;
endings and hook code may use either. A value can never change where the URL goes:
placeholders are refused in the origin and every value is pattern-checked and encoded.
RedirectTemplate.title: RedirectTemplate

Ref.description:
Reference to a question (or recorded variable) by id. Not-reached or
irrelevant questions evaluate to null (§3).
Ref.title: Ref

Retention.title: Retention

RichList.description: A bulleted (`ul`) or numbered (`ol`) list; one inline run per item, no nesting.
RichList.title: RichList

RichText.description:
The rich-text variant of `Text`: `{"type": "rich", "blocks": [...]}`. `type` and
`blocks` are not language tags, so the union with a translation map is unambiguous.
RichText.title: RichText

SliderQuestion.description:
A number picked on a track from `min` to `max` in `step`s. Starts unanswered: no
value until the participant sets one (runtime-design.md §6; semantics.md §2, C2c-3).
Stored like an `integer` or `decimal` answer, by `valueType`.
SliderQuestion.title: SliderQuestion

Source.description:
Where an inserted question, page or block came from: which bank item, which version,
which library. Written only by the bank insert op; the runtime never reads it. A matrix
row has the source of its matrix; an item without one has its page's, then its block's.
Source.title: Source

TextLit.description: Text literal, e.g. ``"b"``. Also used for text choice codes (§2).
TextLit.title: TextLit

TextRun.description:
A run of text: `marks` ⊆ {b, i}; `href` (an absolute https URL) makes it a link;
`lang` is a per-run language span.
TextRun.title: TextRun

Theme.description: A survey theme. Fields are design tokens; there is no free-form CSS here.
Theme.title: Theme

description: An `osp-survey` document. Reaching the end of `flow` means `end: complete` (§6).
title: Survey
